basic_details.short_information: Indian Institute of Management Mumbai has four Group A posts open, one post each and all UR: Deputy General Manager (Career Development Services) at Pay Level 12, and Medical Officer, Manager (Civil) and Manager (Electrical) at Pay Level 10 as per the 7th CPC. The posts are on a Regular/ Contract/ Tenure basis under Advt. No. Admn/Rectt/2026/41 dated 19 October 2026. Applications are accepted only online through the IIM Mumbai careers page (iimmumbai.ac.in/careers), from 19 October 2026 to 9 November 2026 (05:00 PM).

how_to_apply: IIM Mumbai accepts only online applications. Offline applications are not part of this advertisement.
Go to the official IIM Mumbai careers page at https://iimmumbai.ac.in/careers. The online option is open from 19 October 2026.
Choose one post only. A candidate can apply for one post only.
Enter your email ID in the application form. This is mandatory, and all correspondence, including the written test/interview call letter, will be sent to that email ID.
Upload a recent photograph (not older than six months) and copies of the certificates listed under Documents Required.

If you work in a Government/Semi-Government/Public Sector Undertaking, apply through proper channel and submit a No Objection Certificate from your present employer when filling out the online application.
Pay the non-refundable application processing fee of Rs.590/- unless you are exempted.
Submit the online application by 9 November 2026 (05:00 PM).
important_instructions: Incomplete applications without proper supporting documents will be summarily rejected. Check your eligibility before applying. No inquiry seeking advice on eligibility will be entertained. The Institute will contact only candidates shortlisted for the written test/interview and will not send rejection letters. Emails or calls asking for status updates, interim correspondence and personal inquiries will not be entertained. This includes inquiries about the conduct or result of the selection process or reasons for not being called. Canvassing of any nature, or bringing any influence or pressure from any quarter, will be considered a disqualification for the post. Candidature may be rejected at any stage for malpractice or for not meeting the qualification, experience or other eligibility conditions, and such candidates are liable to legal action. If an inadvertent error is found at any stage, even after an appointment letter has been issued, the Institute reserves the right to modify, withdraw or cancel without prior communication. During the selection process, the Institute reserves the right to ask candidates already in service for any other certificate, including vigilance clearance. Any addendum, deletion or corrigendum will be posted only on the Institute's website, www.iimmumbai.ac.in, where updates will also appear. For technical assistance, contact [email protected]. Legal disputes, if any, are restricted to the jurisdiction of Mumbai only.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms
content_sections.text: Basis of appointment: the posts are advertised on a Regular/ Contract/ Tenure basis. The initial appointment will be on tenure/deputation for a period of 5 years. Exceptionally deserving selected candidates may have a tenure/deputation of appointment as per the Institute's requirement. Consolidated pay: the Institute may consider hiring candidates on a suitable consolidated monthly remuneration basis, as it deems fit. Lower post: a candidate may be hired for a lower post if the Institute deems it fit. Deputation: officers holding analogous posts on a regular basis in their parent cadre/department may also apply for appointment on a deputation basis. A deputationist may be considered for absorption, subject to the needs of the post, the officer's suitability, the consent of the lending and borrowing organisations, and the applicable Government of India rules on absorption as amended from time to time. Being considered for absorption gives the deputationist no vested right. Accommodation: selected candidates will be given accommodation on the Institute campus or in leased accommodation, with electricity and water charges paid as actual. A candidate who is given this accommodation will not be eligible for House Rent Allowance. Medical facilities: Institute employees and their dependents get medical facilities as per Institute rules. Children Education Allowance: admissible at the applicable rate for up to two children, as per Central Government Norms. Commitment: all the positions require a full 24x7 commitment to the Institute. Provisional appointment: appointment orders issued to finally selected candidates are provisional. The Institute will verify antecedents and documents (character/antecedent/Police verification, all original documents, experience certificate and other documents). If any fact or document is later found to be fabricated or altered, or a candidate with a doubtful background has hidden it, the candidature will stand cancelled and their services may be terminated.

content_sections.heading: IIM Mumbai Recruitment 2026 Job Description
content_sections.text: Lead and oversee the Career Development Services function, including placements, internships, corporate relations and employer engagement. Develop and implement strategic initiatives to strengthen industry and alumni partnerships, enhance student employability and employer outreach, and promote the Institute's brand among leading recruiters. Establish effective policies, processes and systems for placement operations. Align career development initiatives with industry requirements. Provide strategic insights to senior management based on placement trends and outcomes. Lead initiatives for continuous improvement, innovation and stakeholder engagement. Undertake any other duties assigned by the Competent Authority. Oversee the Institute's Wellness Centre, managing all administrative and functional operations. Provide medical care to students and staff, and maintain health records. Coordinate with hospitals and verify medical claims. Ensure availability of medicines and first aid. Look after campus sanitation and hostel and mess inspections, and ensure overall healthcare readiness. Other duties assigned by the Institute. Maintain, manage, develop and provide technical support for campus physical infrastructure in the respective disciplines. Critically evaluate and provide constructive inputs on all project documentation submitted by internal departments and external agencies to the Administration. Implement and follow up on policy and legal matters pertaining to all construction projects of the Institute, including arbitration and court matters, wherever required. Supervise and monitor civil infrastructure works, including site execution, technical scrutiny of drawings and specifications, quality control, and verification of measurements. Coordinate with contractors, review project progress and provide support in billing certification. Ensure statutory compliance and proper project documentation, and resolve technical and execution-related issues. Any other task(s) assigned by the competent authorities of the Institute from time to time. Maintain, manage, develop and provide technical support for campus physical infrastructure in the electrical discipline. Implement and follow up on the Institute's policies relating to electrical works under construction and maintenance projects. Prepare electrical designs, specifications, load calculations, and tender packages. Supervise execution and ensure quality control of electrical works, and verify contractor bills. Coordinate with architects, civil engineering teams, other agencies, and statutory authorities on electrical installations. Monitor project progress and maintain project records. Promote energy efficiency and net-zero campus practices in electrical installations. Perform any other task(s) assigned by the competent authorities of the Institute from time to time.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: Selection starts with scrutiny/screening of applications. After that, the Institute may hold a written test and/or skill test and/or interview and/or any other test for shortlisted candidates. The Institute reserves the right to revise its criteria for shortlisting candidates for all advertised positions. All applications will be scrutinised, and only applicants who clear scrutiny will be called for the next stage. A duly constituted Screening Committee will shortlist candidates using suitable criteria. Candidates should list in the application all qualifications and experience in the relevant area that go beyond the minimum, supported with documents. Meeting the minimum qualification/experience does not automatically entitle an applicant to be called for further stages. Where it is not possible or convenient to process all eligible applications, the Institute may limit the number of applicants called for the next stage based on qualifications and/or experience higher than the minimum prescribed. The Institute may decide to hold a written test and/or skill test and/or interview and/or any other test/selection process it deems appropriate, only for the shortlisted candidates. Originals will be checked at the interview. Shortlisted candidates must bring all original certificates, degrees and other documents for educational qualification, professional qualification, work experience, age, etc., together with one set of photocopies of these documents. The Institute's decision on eligibility, screening/written test and selection is final and binding.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for IIM Mumbai Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Go to the official IIM Mumbai careers page at https://iimmumbai.ac.in/careers. The online option is open from 19 October 2026. Choose one post only. A candidate can apply for one post only. Enter your email ID in the application form. This is mandatory, and all correspondence, including the written test/interview call letter, will be sent to that email ID. Upload a recent photograph (not older than six months) and copies of the certificates listed under Documents Required. If you work in a Government/Semi-Government/Public Sector Undertaking, apply through proper channel and submit a No Objection Certificate from your present employer when filling out the online application. Pay the non-refundable application processing fee of Rs.590/- unless you are exempted. Submit the online application by 9 November 2026 (05:00 PM).

content_sections.heading: Documents Required
content_sections.text: A latest photograph, not older than six months. Certificates of qualification(s), from matriculation onwards. Experience certificate(s) on the issuing organisation's letterhead, showing the date of issue, the specific period of work, the designation and the pay drawn for each position, duly certified by the competent issuing authority. Proof of date of birth. Caste/category certificate. Candidates claiming reservation or a fee concession for SC/ST/OBC (NCL)/EWS/PwBD/Ex-servicemen must attach the relevant certificate(s) in the format prescribed by the Central Government. For ST candidates: the caste validity certificate issued by the Scheduled Tribe Certificate Scrutiny Committee of the respective State Government, enclosed with the application. For OBC (NCL) reservation (where the post is reserved for OBC): a self-declaration as per Annexure – I, along with a certificate in the prescribed format issued by the Competent Authority. For PwBD candidates: a valid disability certificate issued by a competent medical authority in the prescribed format. Candidates seeking horizontal reservation and/or age relaxation under PwBD must submit it at the time of application and produce the original at document verification/joining. PwBD reservation is given as per the Rights of Persons with Disabilities Act, 2016 and the Government of India orders under it, where the post is identified as suitable for or reserved for PwBD candidates. For EWS (where the post is reserved for EWS): the EWS certificate in the Government of India format, produced at document verification by candidates shortlisted for it. EWS covers persons not under the SC, ST or OBC reservation whose family gross annual income is below Rs. 8.00 lakh. "Family" means the applicant, parents, siblings below 18, spouse and children below 18. Income from all sources counts (salary, agriculture, business, profession, etc.) for the financial year before the year of application. A person is excluded from EWS, whatever the family income, if the family owns 5 acres of agricultural land and above; a residential flat of 1000 sq. ft. and above; a residential plot of 100 sq. yards and above in notified municipalities; or a residential plot of 200 sq. yards and above in areas other than notified municipalities. Income and assets must be certified by an officer not below the rank of Tehsildar in the State/UT concerned. No Objection Certificate from the present employer, for candidates working in Government/Semi-Government/Public Sector Undertakings. Original certificates, to be produced at the selection process and again at joining, if selected.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in IIM Mumbai Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 4 vacancies, one UR post each for Deputy General Manager (Career Development Services), Medical Officer, Manager (Civil) and Manager (Electrical).

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for IIM Mumbai Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date for online applications is 9 November 2026 (05:00 PM). The online window opened on 19 October 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What qualification is needed for the IIM Mumbai Manager (Civil) and Manager (Electrical) posts?
faq.answer: Each post needs a Bachelor's degree (B.E./B.Tech) in its own engineering discipline (Civil or Electrical) from a recognized university with a minimum of 60% marks, plus a minimum of 10 years of relevant experience. Candidates with an M.E./M.Tech. in that discipline get a two-year relaxation in the experience requirement.

faq.question: Q4. What is the qualification for the IIM Mumbai Medical Officer post?
faq.answer: The qualification is an MBBS Degree from a recognised university with 05 years' experience as Medical officer in a reputed hospital or dispensary, OR MD, or MS, in an appropriate branch of Medicine.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for IIM Mumbai Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The limit is 45 years as on the closing date for online applications for Deputy General Manager (Career Development Services), Manager (Civil) and Manager (Electrical). For Medical Officer, the age is preferably below 45 years. SC/ST/OBC/PwD/Ex-serviceman candidates get relaxation as per existing rules, and departmental candidates have no age bar.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary for the IIM Mumbai posts?
faq.answer: Deputy General Manager (Career Development Services) is at Pay Level 12 as per the 7th CPC. Medical Officer, Manager (Civil) and Manager (Electrical) are at Pay Level 10 as per the 7th CPC.

faq.answer: The non-refundable application processing fee is Rs.590/-. SC, ST and PwBD candidates and all internal candidates are exempted.

faq.answer: A Screening Committee first scrutinises and shortlists applications. The Institute may then hold a written test and/or skill test and/or interview and/or any other test for the shortlisted candidates only.

faq.question: Q9. Can I apply for more than one post in IIM Mumbai Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: No. The notice states that a candidate can apply for one post only.
